From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: OptiBank enterprise access: SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist playbook

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. To make the access controls portion of onboarding smooth, attached is a short playbook and the SAML metadata you can drop into OptiBank's IdP.

High-level checklist (we'll cover on Monday's call):
- SSO / SAML: exchange metadata (attached: saml-metadata.xml). Please confirm your IdP supports SP-initiated SLO, but SP-initiated SSO is sufficient to start.
- SCIM: we'll provision users and groups via SCIM v2. See the attribute map (attached: scim-attribute-map.xlsx). We need your primaryEmail, externalId, and groups attributes.
- IP allowlist: we'll require the list of outbound IPs (we've included our default pool in optibank-iplist.csv); let us know if you need a NAT or proxy IP instead.
- Service accounts: we'll create a scoped service account for your provisioning jobs — details in service-account-guidelines.pdf. Minimum required scopes: scim:write, users:read.

Please review the attachments and reply with any constraints (e.g., attribute naming, SCIM provisioning schedule). Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm IdP metadata and SCIM attribute acceptance by Tue 04/13 EOD.
2) Engineering (cc'd) will provision a test service account and share credentials over our secure vault.
3) Test provisioning in a staging org; go-live when all users sync and SSO passes.

If helpful I can include our security checklist for audit teams.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Customer Security Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (XML), scim-attribute-map.xlsx (XLSX), optibank-iplist.csv (CSV), service-account-guidelines.pdf (PDF)

Hi Elena — copying the team with technical details.

Short answers:
- Service accounts: we will NOT create service accounts in your IdP. We will host the service account used for SCIM calls on Redwood and provide credentials that OptiBank can rotate; this aligns with your preference.
- Attribute mapping: our SCIM adapter supports attribute aliases. We can map "mail" -> userName/primaryEmail on our side. I'll attach a sample mapping CSV and the scim-schema-v2.md for reference.
- Groups-first sync: supported. Implementation notes:
  * We recommend an initial groups-only sync to populate group objects; then run user provisioning with a low-rate first pass (e.g., 100 users/hour) to validate invites.
  * We support delta syncs via changeToken; full syncs are possible but slower.
- Service account scopes: for the token we host, we will restrict to scim:Users.write, scim:Groups.read, users:read. No admin-level scopes.
- IP allowlist: once you provide CIDRs we'll update firewall rules; for staging we can open a temporary tunnel. Please confirm if you require mutual TLS for the SCIM endpoint.

Next steps: I'm attaching scim-schema-v2.md and sample-mapping.csv. If the mappings look good I can schedule the staging sync for Wed 04/14 09:00 PT.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-schema-v2.md (MD), sample-mapping.csv (CSV)
